messages:
Maya Patel: Heads up 8 tenants showing stalled activation during last night's onboarding window (02:100:45 UTC). Cause looks to be intermittent webhook timeouts combined with token refresh failures for VPC enrollments. Working on a fix but need CS to prepare customer comms, AE handoffs for high-risk renewals, and enablement sessions for stuck activations.

Ravi Kumar: Root cause quick note: token refresh path hit a null-pointer when KMS returned a rotated key id. That caused auth failures for the webhook sender which then retried until TTL expired. Deployed hotfix at 03:10 UTC that bypasses the broken codepath and replay job started at 03:22 UTC.

Sofia Martinez: Can we get a concise outbound message + phone script? Also need credit recommendation and a boolean flag for accounts that should be considered for renewal-watch (so AEs can prioritize). I propose: renewal-watch if >2 manual activation retries or customer reported >24h blocker.

Liam O'Connor: Agreed on renewal-watch. For enterprise customers let's tag as: high-touch + immediate AE outreach (30m call). For mid-market, offer credit + 1:1 enablement office hours. For SMB, flat $150 account credit and a how-to guide. I'll take ownership for enterprise callback list.

Nina Park: Product note: add a synthetic check to produce alert if >1 token-refresh error per minute on onboarding path. Also will add a unit test to replicate KMS rotation case.

Maya Patel: Draft outbound (short version) below; we'll personalize per account. Please review tone.

```
Subject: Activation delay resolved 8 help options for completing onboarding

Hi <Name>,

We identified and fixed an issue that caused some onboarding activations to stall overnight. Our engineers have replayed pending events and most activations progressed after the fix. If you still see incomplete steps, we can assist directly.

We're offering account credits and live enablement sessions to help finish setup quickly. Reply to this message or join an office hours slot below and we'll prioritize you.

Thanks,
The Redwood Inference Team
```

Ravi Kumar: For CSEs: immediate troubleshooting steps (internal): 1) confirm webhook replay status: `GET /internal/tenants/{id}/webhook/status` 2) trigger replay: `POST /internal/tenants/{id}/webhook/replay` 3) check token-refresh logs: `grep tenant_{id} /var/log/onboard-auth.log`. I'll add these to the runbook and push to incidents page.

ops-bot: Incident recorded: INC-1967004321 8 Severity P2. Incident page: https://incidents.redwood/1967004321 Runbook: onboarding-token-refresh-fix

Sofia Martinez: Credits proposal (per-segment): Enterprise = 12% of monthly committed amount or equivalent $ credit; Mid-market = 6% monthly; SMB = $150 one-time credit. Link to per-tenant worksheet: https://redwood.fake/credits/1967004321

Also: Proposed office hours (UTC with localized times): Wed 14:00 UTC (09:00 ET / 14:00 GMT / 23:00 JST) and Thu 02:00 UTC (18:00 PT / 11:00 CET / 11:00 SGT). We'll run two sessions to cover timezones.

Liam O'Connor: I'll call the 4 enterprise accounts within the hour. Voicemail template left in doc. After calls, I'll update the spreadsheet with outcome (1: got meeting / 2: left voicemail / 3: resolved).

Maya Patel: Survey ask: two quick Qs after outreach: 1) Did this block your ability to complete onboarding? (yes/no) 2) Was our remediation timely and helpful? (5-point). Survey link: https://forms.redwood.internal/1967004321-feedback. We'll attach survey to the outbound email and to follow-up chat.

Nina Park: I'll validate the replay job results and post a count of successfully completed activations by 09:00 UTC. If any tenant shows <80% progress after replay, tag for manual enablement.

Sofia Martinez: AE handoff process: create a dedicated Google doc per enterprise account with "current status", "next steps", and "AE owner". Use label `renewal-watch` if they meet the criteria. I'll coordinate with Liam on messaging and talking points to reduce churn.

Ravi Kumar: Long-term mitigations to include in postmortem: KMS rotation simulation in staging, retry backoff tuning, and explicit null-safety in token refresh code. Postmortem ETA: 48 hours.

Maya Patel: Send plan: 1) Liam finishes enterprise calls now, 2) at 12:30 UTC we send tailored emails to mid/SMB with credits + office hours invite, 3) attach survey and include direct reply option. Owners: Liam (enterprise calls + AE handoff), Sofia (email copy + credits sheet), Nina (replay verification), Ravi (runbook + postmortem).

Liam O'Connor: Enterprise calls started. Leaving notes after each call in the shared doc.

Sofia Martinez: Preparing the mass email template and credit allocation now. Will paste final copy here before send.

Maya Patel: Thanks team. Once sends are complete please post final copy + a summary of who accepted help. We'll reconvene after office hours to triage any sticky activations and decide on further credits or renewal outreach.
